## Verification Checklist

Before submitting, please ensure the following pass locally:

- [ ] `pnpm format` (formatted with Prettier)
- [ ] `pnpm check` (SvelteKit & Svelte 5 compiler diagnostics: 0 errors, 0 warnings)
- [ ] `pnpm lint` (ESLint and Prettier check pass)
- [ ] `pnpm test` (all 27 Vitest unit & integration tests pass)
- [ ] `pnpm build` (production build succeeds)
- [ ] Responsive design verified on mobile viewports (<640px, if UI changes)
- [ ] Verified in both Dark Mode and Light Mode (if UI changes)
